# GeoInno

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

GeoInno provides tools for patent-data research in the Geography of Innovation. Its `structural_diversity()` function calculates a Network Diversity Score (NDS) from patent co-occurrence networks. `complexity_frontier()` aggregates a technology-specific index to spatial units.

## Structural Diversity in GeoInno 2.0

The recommended estimator samples up to `n_starts = 125` starting vertices from the largest connected component. For each start, a random walk stops when `n_nodes = 150` **distinct vertices** have been visited; smaller components are used in full. The estimator averages finite sample-level iNDS values, records undefined values as missing, and does not cap raw NDS at 1. It returns `Structural_raw` and `Structural_neglog = -log(Structural_raw)` for positive raw values. Negative transformed values are legitimate when raw NDS exceeds 1. `n_samples`, `n_valid_samples`, and `share_valid_samples` show how much sampled information was usable. The `seed` argument gives reproducible results with one or multiple workers.

The historical fixed-step estimator remains available as `structural_diversity_legacy()` for reproducing analyses based on earlier GeoInno versions. Its `node.sample` argument counts starting vertices, and `reps` counts random-walk steps, not bootstrap repetitions. Its historical RNG, undefined-value treatment, and transformation are preserved.

The package requires the packages **igraph**, **tidyverse**, **widyr**,**future**, **future.apply** and **data.table** to be installed.

## References

Broekel, T., 2019. Using structural diversity to measure the complexity of technologies. PLoS One 14, 1–27. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0216856
Mewes, L., Broekel, T., 2022. Technological complexity and economic growth of regions. Res. Policy 51, 104156. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.respol.2020.104156


## Installation

You can install GeoInno from [GitHub](https://github.com/tombroekel/GeoInno) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("tombroekel/GeoInno")
```

## Example

The corrected estimator is the default choice:

```{r example, eval=F}
library(GeoInno)
## Calculate structural diversity using artificial data set pat_df

complexity <- structural_diversity(pat_df)
complexity$Structural_raw
complexity$Structural_neglog

## Reproduce the historical fixed-step implementation
complexity_legacy <- structural_diversity_legacy(pat_df)
```
